item.title: Foreign Ministry on Japanese ship passing through Hormuz: "Actively seeking solutions to break the current deadlock" (외교부, 일본 선박 호르무즈 통과에 “상황 타개 방안 적극 모색”)
item.description:
Regarding a Japanese oil tanker that passed through the Strait of Hormuz with permission from Iranian authorities, the Foreign Ministry stated on the 29th that it is exploring ways for ships related to South Korea to pass through as well. (일본 유조선 한 척이 이란 당국의 허가를 받아 호르무즈해협을 통과한 데 대해 외교부는 한국 관련 선박들의 통과를 위한 방안을 찾고 있다고 29일 밝혔다.)

A Foreign Ministry official said on the same day, "Based on our fundamental position, the government is actively seeking measures to overcome the current situation, including consultations between the South Korean and Iranian governments." He added, "We are communicating and cooperating with relevant countries from multiple angles, while also considering the safety of ships and the positions of shipping companies." The government emphasizes as its fundamental stance that, in accordance with relevant international norms, free navigation and safety guarantees for ships of all countries, including South Korea, in the Strait of Hormuz must be achieved promptly. (외교부 당국자는 이날 “정부는 기본 입장 하에 한국-이란 정부 간 협의를 포함해 현 상황 타개를 위한 방안을 적극 모색해 나가고 있다”고 말했다. 또, “선박의 안전과 선박회사 입장도 고려하면서 관련국들과 다각적으로 소통·협력하고 있다”고 덧붙였다. 정부는 관련 국제규범 등에 따라 호르무즈 해협 내 한국을 포함한 모든 나라 선박에 대한 자유로운 항행과 안전 보장이 조속히 이뤄져야 한다는 것을 기본 입장으로 강조하고 있다.)

According to Iranian media and the ship tracking service MarineTraffic, a Panama-flagged very large crude carrier (VLCC) owned by Japanese company Idemitsu Kosan, the *Idemitsu*, left the Strait of Hormuz the previous day with permission from Iranian authorities, loaded with 2 million barrels of crude oil. Japanese media, citing a senior government official, reported that "no passage fee was paid for the strait, and this is a result of government negotiations." It also appears that prior consultations were held with the United States, which continues to enforce a counter-blockade. While intergovernmental diplomatic negotiations are important for ship passage, it is understood that the final decision to pass, given the highly unstable situation in the strait, rests with the shipping company. (이란 매체와 선박 추적 서비스 마린트래픽 등에 따르면, 일본 회사 이데미쓰고산 소유 파나마 선적의 초대형 원유 운반선(VLCC) 이데미쓰호가 전날 원유 200만배럴을 싣고 이란 당국의 허가를 받아 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나왔다. 일본 언론들은 정부 고위 관계자를 인용해 “해협 통행료를 내지 않았고 정부가 협상한 성과”라고 전했다. 또, 역봉쇄를 계속하고 있는 미국과도 사전 협의가 이뤄졌던 것으로 보인다. 선박 통과는 정부간 외교 협상도 중요하지만, 해협이 극도로 불안정한 상황이라 통과하겠다는 최종 판단은 선사가 하는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Approximately 40 Japanese ships remain in the Strait of Hormuz, and three had previously left earlier this month. Regarding this passage, the Iranian Embassy in Japan stated that "the long-standing ties between Japan and Iran played a role." In the 1950s, when the Iranian government declared the nationalization of its oil industry and faced a maritime blockade from Britain, the founder of Idemitsu Kosan took a risk and secretly sent the *Nissho* to import Iranian crude oil. Since then, the relationship between Japan, which lacks oil resources, and Iran, which needs stable buyers, has been maintained for over 70 years. (호르무즈해협에는 일본 선박 40여척이 머무르고 있는데 이달 초에도 3척이 빠져나온 적이 있다. 이번 선박 통과에는 “일본과 이란의 오래된 인연이 작용했다”고 주일본이란대사관이 밝히기도 했다. 1950년대 이란 정부가 석유 산업 국유화를 선언했다가 영국으로부터 해상 봉쇄를 당했고, 당시 이데미쓰고산 창업자가 위험을 무릅쓰고 비밀리에 닛쇼호를 보내 이란 원유를 수입한 바 있다. 이후 석유 자원이 부족한 일본과 안정적 구매자가 필요한 이란의 관계는 70년 넘게 유지돼왔다.)

After the US-Israel-Iran war, 26 ships related to South Korea remain in the Strait of Hormuz. South Korea sent a special envoy from the Foreign Ministry to Iran and held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, but no concrete results, such as ship passage, have been achieved yet. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 이후 호르무즈해협에는 한국 관련 선박 26척이 머무르고 있다. 한국은 이란에 외교부 장관 특사를 파견해 아바스 아라그치 이란 외무장관과 면담하기도 했으나, 아직 선박 통과 등 구체적 성과는 나오지 않고 있다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Personnel reshuffle for minister-level officials and North Korea desk at the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. amid mounting bilateral challenges (한·미 산적한 과제 속 주미대사관 공사급·북미라인 교체)
item.description:
As challenges between South Korea and the United States pile up—including restrictions on sharing North Korea-related intelligence, the Coupang conflict, and delays in security sector negotiations—the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has initiated a personnel reshuffle involving minister-level officials at the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. and the North America desk. <<> According to a diplomatic source on the 29th, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs plans to replace the economic minister and the public diplomacy minister at the Washington embassy. Kim Sun-young, Director General for Bilateral Economic Affairs, has been appointed as the new economic minister, and Yoon Joo-seok, Director General for Consular Safety, as the new public diplomacy minister, with both expected to assume their posts next month. Current Economic Minister Ahn Se-ryung and Public Diplomacy Minister Kim Hak-jo are reportedly returning to work at the ministry's headquarters. <<> The position of political minister at the embassy, which has been vacant for several months, is expected to be filled soon. After the previous political minister was reassigned to another diplomatic post, the public diplomacy minister had been concurrently handling political minister duties. There has also been controversy over whether the Washington embassy responded adequately while Coupang, after causing a customer information leak, turned the issue into one of "discrimination against American companies" through lobbying in Washington, escalating it into a major diplomatic problem between the two countries. <<> In addition, the Director General for North American Affairs at the ministry's headquarters, responsible for U.S. affairs, is also set to be replaced soon. This means that both the ministry's headquarters and the embassy in the U.S. will see simultaneous changes in those handling U.S. diplomacy. This "renewal reshuffle" draws attention as it comes amid numerous pending issues between South Korea and the U.S. However, there is also the aspect that, as ministry personnel changes have continuously been delayed even after the new government took office, overdue reshuffles are occurring all at once, far beyond the usual tenure periods. A ministry official stated, "It's just that those who have served beyond their standard terms are included in the reshuffle, changing according to a natural personnel cycle, so there's no need to attach excessive significance by linking it to the South Korea-U.S. relationship." <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (한미간에 대북 정보 공유 제한, 쿠팡 갈등, 안보 분야 협상 지연 등 과제가 쌓이고 있는 가운데 외교부가 주미대사관 공사들과 북미 라인을 교체하는 인사에 나섰다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon Embrace at Gupo Market… "Fighting" "Let's Do This Productively" (하정우·한동훈, 구포시장서 포옹…“파이팅” “생산적으로 해봅시다”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former presidential secretary for AI future strategy, who officially declared his candidacy for the June 3 by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district, and Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party, embraced at Busan's Gupo Market on the 29th. (6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 부산 북갑 출마를 공식화한 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석과 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표가 29일 부산 구포시장에서 포옹했다.)

The former secretary Ha and former leader Han crossed paths while touring Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, that afternoon. Former Secretary Ha greeted former leader Han, saying, "You need to stay healthy. Fighting!" Han replied, "Let's do this productively." To this, former Secretary Ha responded, "Yes, constructively and progressively, together," and former leader Han added, "Great. Take care of your health." (하 전 수석과 한 전 대표는 이날 오후 부산 북구 구포시장을 돌다가 마주쳤다. 하 전 수석은 한 전 대표에게 “건강하셔야 합니다. 파이팅입니다”라고 인사했고, 한 전 대표는 “생산적으로 한 번 해봅시다”라고 답했다. 이에 하 전 수석은 “네, 건설적으로 발전적으로 같이”라고 했고, 한 전 대표도 “좋습니다. 건강 챙기세요”라고 말했다.)

During the 20-second encounter, former leader Han remarked, "It's been a while. You seem a bit thinner," to which former Secretary Ha laughed and said, "I gained weight, but then work got tough." Former leader Han patted former Secretary Ha on the shoulder, and the two shook hands. The previous day, the two candidates had engaged in a war of words on social media, with Han asking, "Did the president order you to run?" and Ha replying, "I persuaded the boss." For the People Power Party's candidate in the Busan Buk-gu by-election, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik is being mentioned, and there are also calls within the party for "no nomination." (20초간 만남에서 한 전 대표가 “오랜만에 뵙네요. 좀 마르신 것 같다”고 하자, 하 전 수석은 “살이 쪘다가 일이 빡세서”라며 웃기도 했다. 한 전 대표가 하 전 수석의 어깨를 두드리거나 두 사람이 손을 맞잡기도 했다. 두 후보는 전날 에스엔에스(SNS)를 통해 “대통령이 출마를 지시했냐”(한 후보), “내가 통님을 설득했다”(하 후보) 등 신경전을 벌였다. 부산 북갑 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보로는 박민식 전 국가보훈처 장관 등이 거론되며, 국민의힘 내에서 ‘무공천’ 주장도 나오고 있다.)

By Jang Na-rae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 14 by-elections in the June 3 local elections ‘mini general election level’… Who will be the winner? [Gongdeok Pocha] (6·3 지방선거 재보선 14곳 ‘미니 총선급’…승리자는 누구? [공덕포차])
item.description:
The re-elections and by-elections for National Assembly seats held alongside the June 3 local elections have been finalized at 14 locations on the 29th. As the scale grows to ‘mini general election level,’ competition among candidates from each party has intensified. In particular, the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul district, where candidates including Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party, Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, Cho Kuk of the Fatherland Innovation Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party are running, forming a five-way race, is considered a ‘hot spot’ in this by-election. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재·보궐 선거가 14곳으로 29일 확정됐습니다. ‘미니 총선급’으로 판이 커지면서 각 당 후보들의 경쟁도 한층 치열해졌는데요. 특히 △더불어민주당 김용남 △국민의힘 유의동 △조국혁신당 조국 △진보당 김재연 △자유와혁신 황교안 후보가 출마해 5자 구도가 형성된 경기 평택을은 이번 재보선의 ‘핫 플레이스’로 꼽힙니다.)

In Busan Buk-gu-gap, former Blue House AI Future Planning Senior Secretary Ha Jeong-woo is likely to receive the Democratic Party’s nomination, leading to expectations of a three-way race alongside former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon and former People Power Party lawmaker Park Min-sik. In both Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul and Busan Buk-gu-gap, whether candidates will unify is expected to be a key issue. (부산 북갑에서는 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획 수석이 민주당의 공천을 받을 것이 유력해지면서 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표, 박민식 전 국민의힘 의원과 함께 3파전이 예상되는데요. 경기 평택을과 부산 북갑 모두 후보들 간의 단일화 여부가 최대 쟁점이 될 것으로 보입니다.)

Can former leader Han Dong-hoon achieve unification with the People Power Party candidate in Busan Buk-gu-gap? Among the candidates in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, who have similar approval ratings in a five-way race, who will ultimately seize victory? Can the Democratic Party win in several of the 16 metropolitan cities and provinces in this local election? We explore this on <Gongdeok Pocha>. Check out the video! (한동훈 전 대표는 부산 북갑에서 국민의힘 후보와 단일화를 이뤄낼 수 있을까요? 5자 구도 속에서 엇비슷한 지지율을 보이는 경기 평택을의 후보들 가운데 최종 승리를 거머쥘 사람은 누구일까요? 민주당은 이번 지방선거에서 16곳의 광역시도 가운데 몇 곳에서 승리를 거둘 수 있을까요? <공덕포차>에서 알아봅니다. 영상으로 확인하시죠!)

item.title: Minister Jeong Dong-young on opposition's impeachment motion: "Are you U.S. congressmen? Your worship of America is excessive" (정동영 장관, 야당 해임건의안에 “미 의원이냐…숭미 너무 지나쳐”)
item.description:
Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young said on the 29th, addressing the opposition party that proposed an impeachment motion against him, "On security matters, their worship of America seems far too excessive." (정동영 통일부 장관이 자신의 해임건의안을 발의한 야당을 향해 “안보 사안에 대해 숭미가 너무 지나친 것 같다”고 29일 말했다.)

Minister Jeong made these remarks to reporters after attending the '3rd 2030 Youth Advisory Group Inauguration Ceremony and Minister-Youth Dialogue' held at the Odusan Unification Observatory in Gyeonggi Province. He stated, "It is in the national interest to say that the U.S.'s restrictions on sharing North Korea-related information are forced, inappropriate, and should be lifted quickly." (정 장관은 이날 경기도 오두산통일전망대에서 열린 ‘제3기 2030청년자문단 발대식 및 장관-청년 대화’에 참석한 뒤 기자들과 만나 “미국의 (대북) 정보 공유 제한이 억지스럽다, ‘안 맞다’ ‘빨리 풀라’고 말하는 것이 국익”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

On the 24th, the People Power Party submitted an impeachment motion to the National Assembly, claiming that the recent U.S. restrictions on sharing North Korea-related information were due to Minister Jeong's remarks about a nuclear facility in Gangseong, North Korea. Minister Jeong had previously mentioned during his confirmation hearing in July last year and at the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee on March 6 that there is a uranium enrichment facility in Gangseong, North Korea. (지난 24일 국민의힘은 최근 미국의 대북 정보 공유 제한의 원인이 정 장관의 북한 구성시 핵시설 발언 때문이라며 국회에 해임건의안을 제출했다. 정 장관은 지난해 7월 장관 인사청문회와 지난 3월6일 국회 외교통일위원회 당시 북한 구성시에 우라늄 농축시설이 있다고 발언한 바 있다.)

In response, Minister Jeong criticized the opposition party on this day, saying, "When the U.S. raised an issue, they panicked and started making a fuss. Are you U.S. congressmen? Members of the Korean National Assembly represent the people and must represent the national interest. They should handle (the information-sharing restrictions) in a bipartisan manner." Regarding the claim by People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok that pushing for public discussion to refer to North Korea by its official name, 'Joseon,' also serves as grounds for the impeachment motion, Minister Jeong said, "That is their logic, and it is not the view of the majority of the people." (이에 대해 정 장관은 이날 야당을 향해 “미국이 문제를 제기하자 화들짝, 법석을 떨기 시작했다”며 “미국 국회의원이냐. 한국 국회의원은 국민의 대표고, 국익을 대표해야 한다. (정보 공유 제한에) 초당적으로 대처해야 한다”고 비판했다. 북한을 정식 국호인 ‘조선’으로 부르자며 공론화를 추진하는 것도 해임 건의의 근거가 된다는 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표의 주장에 대해선 정 장관은 “그분들의 논리고, 국민 다수의 시각은 아니”라고 말했다.)

On a recent article in the foreign affairs magazine Foreign Affairs by Victor Cha, a Korea Chair at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) known for his hardline stance on North Korea, Minister Jeong commented, "The (article) is a confession that the policy of complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization (CVID) and sanctions-only approach has failed." He added, "For a scholar with a conservative hardline perspective to suggest removing North Korea from the list of enemies is a remarkably insightful observation." (대북 강경론자인 빅터 차 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 한국석좌가 최근 외교 전문지 포린어페어스에 쓴 기고문에 대해선 정 장관은 “(기고문 내용은) 완전하고 검증 가능하며 비가역적인 비핵화(CVID)와 제재 일변도 정책이 실패했다는 고백”이라며 “보수 강경 시각을 가진 학자가 북한을 적의 명단에서 빼라고 이야기한 것은 굉장히 놀라운 통찰”이라고 말했다.)

In Foreign Affairs, Victor Cha pointed out the failure of existing U.S. policy on North Korea and argued for the need for arms reduction based on acknowledging the reality of North Korea's nuclear weapons possession. Cha also said on the 28th (local time), "Focusing solely on the rhetoric of denuclearization, which has achieved nothing while North Korea continues to enhance its nuclear capabilities, is not a good way to protect the U.S.," proposing a shift in U.S. policy toward North Korea. (빅터 차 석좌는 포린어페어스에서 기존 미국의 대북 정책 실패를 지적하고, 북한의 핵무기 보유 현실을 인정하는 바탕 위에 군축의 필요성 등을 주장했다. 차 석좌는 지난 28일(현지시각)에도 “북한이 계속 핵 능력을 증강하는 동안 아무런 성과를 거두지 못한 비핵화 구호에만 집중하는 것은 미국을 보호하기 위한 좋은 방안이 아니”라며 미국의 대북 정책 전환을 제안했다.)

item.title: 14 by-elections ‘mini general election’… heavyweight figures’ fate gauges political realignment (재보선 14곳 ‘미니 총선’…중량급 인사 당락, 정치 재편 가늠자)
item.description:
Alongside the June 3 local elections, parliamentary by-elections will be held in 14 constituencies nationwide. This is the first nationwide election held one year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration and following the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol. The Democratic Party of Korea expects a ‘landslide victory’ in these elections, which are comparable to a mini general election, while the People Power Party anticipates a win in the Yeongnam region. In particular, the outcomes for heavyweight figures, such as former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil, Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, and former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, are drawing attention as they are closely tied to future internal party dynamics. <<> On the 29th, eight Democratic Party lawmakers, including Representative Choo Mi-ae (Gyeonggi Hanam Gap), who was confirmed as the party’s candidate for the metropolitan mayor in the local elections, and People Power Party Representative Choo Kyung-ho (Daegu Dalseong) resigned from their parliamentary seats. Except for Daegu Dalseong, elections are being held in 13 of the 14 constituencies due to the resignation and loss of seats by Democratic Party lawmakers. Incheon Gyeyang-eul and Chungnam Asan-eul, which were formerly constituencies of President Lee Jae-myung and Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, were confirmed early as by-election districts, while three areas—Gyeonggi Ansan Gap, Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan Gap—will hold re-elections after Democratic Party lawmakers received rulings voiding their elections. <<> As of today, the Democratic Party has confirmed nominations for six constituencies: Incheon Yeonsu Gap (Song Young-gil), Incheon Gyeyang-eul (Kim Nam-jun), Gyeonggi Hanam Gap (Lee Kwang-jae), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Nam-guk), Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Kim Yong-nam), and Ulsan Nam Gap (Jeon Tae-jin). The People Power Party has only confirmed nominations for four constituencies: Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Yoo Eui-dong), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Seok-hoon), Chungnam Asan-eul (Kim Min-kyung), and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan Gap (Oh Ji-sung). <<> Amidst this, the victory or defeat of influential figures such as candidates Song Young-gil, Cho Kuk, and Han Dong-hoon is drawing attention. <<> Candidate Song has been strategically nominated in Incheon Yeonsu Gap. The People Power Party has yet to confirm a candidate. If Song is elected and reaches six terms, he will solidify his position as a contender for party leadership. There is also speculation about his potential candidacy in the party convention scheduled for August. Within and outside the party, there are discussions that even if Song does not run for the convention, he could serve as a focal point for the anti-Jung (anti-Jung Cheong-rae) faction in opposition to Representative Jung Cheong-rae. A pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) senior lawmaker said, “Former leader Song’s entry into the National Assembly means one more focal point to check Representative Jung Cheong-rae (in addition to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok), which could lead to significant changes in the party’s power structure.” <<> The outcome for Cho Kuk, a candidate in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, is directly tied to the fate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. If Cho triumphs in a five-way race against Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong, Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon, and Freedom and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Innovation Party will secure its first district lawmaker, and its merger with the Democratic Party may gain momentum after the election. However, if he loses, both his future and that of the Innovation Party become uncertain. For this reason, the Innovation Party is concentrating its efforts on the Pyeongtaek-eul election. A Democratic Party lawmaker from the metropolitan area serving a second term said, “Ahead of the 2028 general election, how much weight is given to the call for the two parties (Democratic Party and Innovation Party) to join forces depends on Cho’s success or failure in this Pyeongtaek-eul election and the subsequent public assessment.” <<> Candidate Han Dong-hoon, who has entered the race in Busan North Gap, could establish himself as a key figure in the conservative realignment process that may unfold after the election if he wins. However, he must first defeat Ha Jung-woo, a former senior presidential secretary for AI future planning, who joined the Democratic Party at an event recruiting talent. At the event in the National Assembly, Representative Jung Cheong-rae praised Ha as “a talent I was eager to recruit, beyond three visits to a humble cottage, even through thirty visits,” and Ha responded in the Busan dialect, saying, “I aim to transform from an AI designer into a practitioner. I will return to the warm embrace of my mother, sister, brother, and friends and surely achieve my vision for my hometown, Busan.” If Han Dong-hoon fails to overcome the hurdle posed by Ha, his political comeback becomes uncertain. <<> Another point of interest in this election is how well candidates from President Lee Jae-myung’s presidential office staff will perform. Ha Jung-woo and former presidential spokesperson Jeon Eun-soo, who joined the Democratic Party alongside him, are expected to run in the Chungnam Asan-eul by-election. Former presidential spokesperson Kim Nam-jun has been nominated in Incheon Gyeyang-eul, President Lee’s former constituency, while former presidential digital communication secretary Kim Nam-guk has secured the nomination in Gyeonggi Ansan Gap. <<> Reporters: Shim Woo-sam, Choi Ha-yan, Go Han-sol, Jang Na-rae, Kim Hae-jung wu32@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거와 함께 국회의원 재보궐선거가 전국 14곳에서 치러진다. 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만이자, 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 뒤 처음 치러지는 전국 단위 선거다. 더불어민주당은 미니 총선급인 이번 선거에서 ‘압승’을, 국민의힘은 영남 지역 승리를 기대한다. 특히 송영길 전 더불어민주당 대표와 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 등 중량급 인사들의 당락은 향후 당내 역학 구도와 맞닿아 있어 관심이 쏠린다.)

item.title: 'Full-Color Five-Way Race' in Pyeongtaek B... "New Faces Are Tempting" "Outsiders Don't Sit Well" (‘총천연색 5파전’ 평택을…“새 인물에 솔깃” “뜨내기들 마뜩잖아”)
item.description:
"Either Candidate Yoo Ui-dong or that Kim Yong-nam guy seems fine. These days, I think elections don't really care about parties. We have to look at the person and vote." (Mr. A, in his 60s) (“유의동씨 아니면 김용남 그분도 괜찮은 거 같아. 이젠 선거라는 게 당하고 상관없는 거 같아요. 인물 위주로 보고 뽑아야죠.”(60대 ㄱ씨))

From progressives to the far-right, from party leaders to former prime ministers—a 'full-color five-way race' has formed for the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek B. Citizens encountered in Pyeongtaek B on the 29th showed reactions as diverse as the election lineup. (진보부터 극우까지, 당대표부터 전 국무총리까지 ‘총천연색 5파전’ 구도가 만들어진 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거. 29일 평택을 지역에서 만난 시민들은 선거 구도만큼이나 다양한 반응을 나타냈다.)

In Pyeongtaek B, a by-election is being held after former Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin, who held the district seat, had his election invalidated finalized in January. (평택을에서는 지역구 의원이었던 이병진 전 더불어민주당 의원이 지난 1월 당선무효형을 확정받으면서 재선거가 열린다.)

This district had been won by parties affiliated with the People Power Party three consecutive times from the 19th general election in 2012. It is home to Camp Humphreys, the largest overseas U.S. military base in the world. However, with the completion of Samsung Electronics' Pyeongtaek Campus factory and the development of Godeok International New Town, a large influx of young people has diluted the conservative lean. As a result, former lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin was elected in the 2024 22nd general election. (이곳은 2012년 19대 총선부터 내리 3차례 국민의힘 계열 정당이 승리했다. 이곳에는 세계 최대의 해외 미군 기지인 캠프 험프리스가 자리잡고 있다. 그러나 삼성전자 평택캠퍼스 공장 준공과 고덕국제신도시 개발로 젊은이들이 대거 유입되면서 보수세가 희석됐다. 그 결과 2024년 22대 총선에서 이병진 전 의원이 당선됐다.)

The Democratic Party has put forward former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who was part of a conservative party until last year, to target centrist and conservative sentiment, while the People Power Party strategically nominated former lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong, who has already served three terms in Pyeongtaek B. Jo Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, has entered the race, as has Kim Jae-yeon, co-chair of the Progressive Party, along with Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Freedom and Innovation Party. (민주당은 지난해까지 보수 정당에 몸담았던 김용남 전 의원을 후보로 내세워 중도·보수 민심을 공략하려 하고, 국민의힘은 이미 평택을에서 3선을 한 유의동 전 의원을 전략공천했다. 조국혁신당에서는 조국 대표가, 진보당에서는 김재연 상임대표가 나섰고, 황교안 자유와혁신 대표도 뛰고 있다.)

So far, no candidate has emerged as a standout in this district. (이곳에서는 아직 어느 후보도 두각을 나타내지 못하고 있다.)

According to a poll released today by 'Yeoronjochat' (surveyed on the 26th-27th, wireless automated response method), Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam received 27.5%, Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Jo Kuk 21.8%, and People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong 18.9%. The support rates for Freedom and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn (10.3%) and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon (6.9%) are also not negligible. In a poll released on the 27th by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI), candidate Jo had 23.4%, Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, and Yoo 21.2% (surveyed on the 25th-26th, wireless automated response method. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (이날 ‘여론조사꽃’ 발표(지난 26~27일 조사, 무선 자동응답 방식)를 보면 김용남 민주당 후보는 27.5%, 조국 조국혁신당 후보 21.8%, 유의동 국민의힘 후보는 18.9%로 나타났다. 황교안 자유와혁신 후보(10.3%)와 김재연 진보당 후보(6.9%)의 지지율도 무시할 수 없는 수준이다. 지난 27일 발표된 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI) 조사에선 조 후보가 23.4%, 김용남 후보가 21.4%, 유 후보가 21.2%였다.(지난 25~26일 조사, 무선 자동응답 방식. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

'Native' Yoo Ui-dong, 'Ruling Party' Kim Yong-nam, or 'Personality Politics' Jo Kuk? (‘토박이’ 유의동이냐, ‘여당’ 김용남이냐, “인물론” 조국이냐)

One of the key issues in the election is that candidate Yoo Ui-dong, who has already served three terms in Pyeongtaek B, is the only native of Pyeongtaek. To overcome this, candidate Kim Yong-nam is emphasizing being "a ruling party candidate who will align with the capable Lee Jae-myung administration," while candidate Jo Kuk is stressing "personality politics." (선거 쟁점 중 하나는 이미 평택을에서 3선을 한 유의동 후보가 유일한 평택 출신이라는 점이다. 이를 넘어서기 위해 김용남 후보는 “일 잘하는 이재명 정부와 발맞출 여당 후보”를, 조국 후보는 “인물론”을 강조하고 있다.)

Citizen reactions were mixed. At the Rodeo Street in Anjeong-ri, Paengseong-eup, a conservative-leaning area, a woman in her 60s who has run a general store for 40 years, said, "People who aren't even from Pyeongtaek are all jumping in. Honestly, it feels like they see Pyeongtaek as a pushover, and it doesn't sit well with me," predicting an advantage for Yoo. However, Lee Gyeong-suk (61), who runs a second-hand clothing store, said, "Whether you're a native or not doesn't matter at all. It's an era where we vote based on ability these days. If the president does well, the people under him inevitably do well too. Kim Yong-nam candidate will create synergy." (시민들 반응은 다양했다. 보수 우세 지역인 팽성읍 안정리 로데오거리에서 40년 동안 잡화점을 해온 60대 여성 ㄱ씨는 “평택 출신도 아닌 사람들이 너도나도 들어오는 게, 솔직히 ‘평택을 호구로 아나’ 싶어 기분이 좋진 않다”며 유 후보의 우위를 점쳤다. 하지만 구제 옷가게를 하는 이경숙(61)씨는 “토박이냐 아니냐는 전혀 상관없다. 지금은 능력을 보고 뽑는 시대”라며 “대통령이 잘하면 그 밑에 있는 사람들도 잘할 수밖에 없다. 김용남 후보가 시너지가 날 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reactions to candidate Jo, who advocates "personality politics," were mixed. Lee said, "He also put a lot of effort into the impeachment issue and seemed sincere. I think he'll do a good job," but Son Nam-ju (30), who lives in Godeok International New Town, said, "I don't know about others, but with Jo Kuk, there's the controversy over his children's school admissions scandal, and doesn't he not even really know this area?" (“인물론”을 내세운 조 후보에 대한 반응은 엇갈렸다. 이씨는 “그분도 탄핵 때 노력을 많이 했던 분이고, 진실성 있어 보였다. 일을 잘할 거라 본다”고 했지만, 고덕국제신도시에 사는 손남주(30)씨는 “다른 사람은 모르겠는데 조국은 자녀 입시 비리 논란도 그렇고, 애초에 이 지역도 잘 모르지 않나”라고 말했다.)

However, some citizens felt skeptical about established politics due to long-unresolved local issues. Jang Hye-suk (60), who has run a mobile phone store for 24 years in Anjung-eup, said, "Local development has been practically nonexistent, so honestly, I have no expectations no matter who comes." There were also signs that 'new faces' could exploit this gap. Mr. A said, "My son in his 30s gave a good evaluation of candidate Kim Jae-yeon. It seems young people also think well of a new face like candidate Kim." (그러나 오랫동안 해결되지 않는 지역 현안 때문에 기성 정치에 회의감을 느끼는 시민들도 있었다. 안중읍에서 24년째 휴대전화 판매점을 운영하고 있는 장혜숙(60)씨는 “그동안 지역 발전이 거의 없다시피 해서 솔직히 누가 나와도 기대가 없다”고 했다. 그 틈을 ‘새 인물’이 파고들 여지도 엿보였다. ㄱ씨는 “30대인 아들이 김재연 후보를 좋게 평가하더라. 젊은 청년들은 새 인물인 김 후보도 좋게 생각하는 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Few individuals mentioned candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn. However, Kim (69), a resident of Poseung-eup who said he supports the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction within the People Power Party, remarked, "Hwang Kyo-ahn is no good. Hwang teamed up with Go Seong-guk and messed up the country. He just keeps shouting about election fraud, leading the country to this state." (황교안 후보에 대해서는 언급하는 인사가 적었다. 다만 국민의힘 내 친한동훈계를 지지한다고 밝힌 포승읍에 사는 김아무개(69)씨는 “황교안씨는 안 된다. 고성국이하고 손잡고 나라 개판 만들어놓은 게 황교안”이라며 “맨 부정선거만 외쳐서 나라가 이 꼴이 됐다”고 말했다.)

'Five-Way Race' Chaos, Possibility of Last-Minute Unification (‘5파전’ 난전, 막판 단일화 가능성도)

Given the close battle where progressive and conservative candidates struggle to gain an edge, the 'last-minute unification' possibility remains open. (진보와 보수 후보들이 우열을 가리기 힘든 접전을 벌이는 만큼 ‘막판 단일화’ 가능성도 여전히 열려 있다.)

In an interview on YouTube's 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory,' candidate Jo said regarding the possibility of unification with Kim Yong-nam, "It's always open," and added, "I think unification talks will only come up around May 21st, the start of the election campaign." Candidate Kim Yong-nam also left the door open, telling The Hankyoreh, "It's too early to discuss unification now, but if I sense that sentiment might shift toward the conservative side, I'll start discussions then." (조 후보는 유튜브 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’ 인터뷰에서 김용남 후보와의 단일화 가능성에 관해 “항상 열려 있다”며 “선거운동 개시일인 5월21일쯤 돼야 단일화 이야기가 비로소 나오지 않을까 생각한다”고 했다. 김용남 후보도 한겨레에 “지금 단일화 논의를 하긴 이르지만, 상황을 봐서 보수 쪽으로 세가 넘어갈 것 같다 싶으면 그때 가서 논의를 시작해 볼 것”이라고 가능성을 열어놨다.)

Citizens responded with "we'll watch the situation." Park (68), a Democratic Party supporter who has run a self-employed business for over 40 years, was reserved, saying, "It seems like we'll have to watch the situation until the end to know about unification. I'm watching with my hands behind my back." (시민들은 “상황을 지켜보겠다”는 반응이다. 민주당 지지자로 40여년 자영업을 해온 박아무개(68)씨는 “단일화는 끝까지 상황을 봐야 알 것 같다. 뒷짐 지고 지켜보고 있다”며 말을 아꼈다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [View briefing] Yun Seok-yeol’s obstruction of arrest appeal sentence: 7 years in prison ([뷰리핑] 윤석열 ‘체포 방해’ 2심 징역 7년)
item.description:
Host: Ha Eo-young, political team reporter at The Hankyoreh. Guests: Attorney Shin In-gyu, political commentator Park Young-sik (진행: 하어영 한겨레 정치팀 기자. 출연: 신인규 변호사, 박영식 시사평론가)

item.title: President Lee: "You don't need a picture with me, right?" Cheon Ha-ram: "I'll take one." (이 대통령 “나랑 사진 찍을 필요 없죠?” 천하람 “찍을게요”)
item.description:
Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, released a photo taken with President Lee Jae-myung, their hands clasped together. (천하람 개혁신당 원내대표가 이재명 대통령과 손을 잡고 찍은 사진을 공개했다.)

Attending a luncheon with President Lee on the 29th, Floor Leader Cheon said on Facebook that afternoon: "After lunch, President Lee suggested taking one-on-one photos with each party attendee and asked, 'Floor Leader Cheon, you don't need a photo with me, right?' I replied, 'No, I'd like to take one too.'" President Lee had invited non-negotiating groups and independent lawmakers to the National Assembly for a luncheon meeting that day. (29일 이 대통령과의 오찬에 참석한 천 원내대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에서 “점심식사 끝나고 이 대통령이 각 당 참석자와 일대일로 사진을 찍자고 권하며 ‘천 대표는 나랑 사진 찍을 필요 없죠?’라고 해서 ‘아닙니다. 저도 같이 찍겠습니다’라고 답했다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 국회 비교섭단체, 무소속 의원들을 초청해 오찬 간담회를 가졌다.)

Floor Leader Cheon added: "Even while taking the photo, the President said, 'This photo will probably never see the light of day,' and we laughed a lot together as we posed. I believe it's the politics of the Reform Party to criticize when necessary and fight when needed, but also laugh and take photos without needing to hide it." (천 원내대표는 “대통령이 사진 찍으면서도 ‘이 사진은 영영 공개될 일 없겠네’라고 해서 함께 크게 웃으면서 사진을 찍었다”면서 “비판할 때는 하고, 싸울 때는 싸우더라도, 웃으면서 사진도 찍고 그것을 숨길 필요 없는 것이 개혁신당의 정치라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

"Though we are the opposition, we won't avoid meeting the President and will speak candidly," Floor Leader Cheon said. "When pointing out issues, we'll do so precisely, and when cooperating, we'll actively prioritize the national interest." He added, "When extreme supporters from both sides and a noisy minority ruin Korean politics, the Reform Party will pursue politics that please the quiet majority. We will protect the lives of that quiet majority." (천 원내대표는 “야당이지만 대통령과 만나는 것을 피하지 않고, 허심탄회하게 대화하겠다”며 “지적할 때는 정확하게 지적하고, 협업할 때는 적극적으로 국익을 우선하겠다”고 했다. 이어 “양 극단의 강성 지지층, 시끄러운 소수가 한국 정치를 망칠 때 개혁신당은 조용한 다수가 보기에 흐뭇한 정치를 하겠다”며 “조용한 다수의 삶을 지키겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

That day, President Lee invited to the presidential office floor leaders Seo Wang-jin of the Fatherland Innovation Party, Yoon Jong-o of the Progressive Party, Cheon Ha-ram of the Reform Party, and Han Chang-min, leader and floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, along with their fellow lawmakers, as well as independents Kim Jong-min and Choi Hyeok-jin, for discussions. This marked the first time President Lee invited all lawmakers from non-negotiating groups, including independents, for a meeting. (이 대통령은 이날 서왕진 조국혁신당 원내대표, 윤종오 진보당 원내대표, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표, 한창민 사회민주당 대표 겸 원내대표를 포함한 소속 의원들과 무소속 김종민·최혁진 의원을 청와대로 초청해 대화를 나눴다. 이 대통령이 무소속을 포함한 비교섭단체 의원 모두를 초청해 만난 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The non-negotiating group and independent lawmakers made several proposals to President Lee. National Assemblyman Seo Wang-jin, floor leader of the Fatherland Innovation Party, who is running for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek, requested that the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support, which includes development plans following the relocation of U.S. military bases in Korea, be converted from a temporary law to a permanent one. Yoon Jong-o, floor leader of the Progressive Party, called for reform of the long-term holding special deduction, which undermines tax equity and causes a "property lock-in" effect. Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, asked for the implementation of a state liability system for teacher lawsuits. Han Chang-min, leader and floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, requested resolution of issues related to Coupang's infringement of labor rights. (비교섭단체와 무소속 의원들은 이 대통령에게 여러 제안을 했다. 조국 대표가 6·3 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 조국혁신당 서왕진 원내대표는 주한미군기지 이전에 따른 개발계획을 담은 평택지원특별법을 한시법이 아닌 상시법으로 전환해달라고 요청했다. 윤종오 진보당 원내대표는 조세 형평성을 훼손하고 ‘매물 잠김’을 초래하는 장기보유특별공제 개편을, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 교사 소송 국가책임제 추진을 요청했다. 한창민 사회민주당 당대표 겸 원내대표는 쿠팡의 노동권 훼손 문제 해결을 요청했다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Granting authority to dismiss indictments in a special counsel for fabricated prosecutions? Not under discussion." (민주 “조작기소 특검에 공소취소권 부여? 논의하고 있지 않다”)
item.description:
<<>> The Democratic Party of Korea denied media reports on the 30th that a draft of its "Special Counsel Act for Investigating Fabricated Prosecutions," prepared as a follow-up to the National Assembly's special committee for investigating alleged fabricated prosecutions by the Yoon Suk Yeol administration's political prosecutors, includes provisions granting authority to dismiss indictments in seven cases, including the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance cases involving leader Lee Jae-myung. The Democratic Party is considering passing the special counsel law before the June 3 local elections, following the conclusion of the special committee's activities today. ()

Jeon Yong-gi, a Democratic Party lawmaker on the special committee, appeared on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus" on this day and stated, "We are not discussing the authority to dismiss indictments. Since the special committee is actually focused on a special counsel to uncover fabricated prosecutions, we believe it cannot directly include the dismissal of indictments." Earlier, one media outlet reported that the draft of the special counsel law being prepared by Democratic Party lawmakers on the special committee includes a clause in the scope of the special counsel's duties that "also covers whether to dismiss indictments in ongoing trials." <<> Regarding Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who handled the Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance case, claiming that "the Democratic Party is pushing for a special counsel and that the special counsel would dismiss the indictment," Jeon said, "I see it as an attempt to shift the narrative to one of 'needing to prevent the dismissal of indictments.' It would be difficult to directly grant the authority to dismiss indictments." However, Jeon added, "If it comes up for discussion, there could be deliberation on maintaining indictments, but we are not reviewing the issue of dismissing indictments." Another Democratic Party official involved with the special committee also told The Hankyoreh, "It's true that the special counsel law includes provisions regarding the filing or maintenance of indictments, but the word 'dismissal of indictment' itself is not even mentioned." <<> Kim Hyun-jung, the Democratic Party's deputy floor leader for communications, met with reporters after a policy coordination meeting at the National Assembly on this day and said, "The draft of the special counsel law is currently being prepared around the special committee, and there has been no discussion or consultation with the floor regarding the preparation of the draft." Regarding the media report about "granting authority to dismiss indictments," she drew a line, stating, "Since the content has not been finalized, it is not appropriate to answer. The content of the special counsel law has not yet been determined." <<> On this day, the special committee plans to hold a plenary session to adopt the final report on the special committee's findings and discuss the referral of perjury witnesses and deposition witnesses for prosecution. Democratic Party lawmakers on the special committee will also hold a press briefing at 11 a.m. to explain the special committee's activities so far. <<> Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 더불어민주당이 국회 윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 후속으로 준비하는 ‘조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’ 초안에 이재명 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등 7개 사건 공소를 취소할 권한을 부여하는 취지의 내용이 담겼다는 언론 보도를 30일 부인했다. 민주당은 이날 활동을 마무리하는 국조특위에 이어 6·3 지방선거 전 특검법을 통과시키는 방안을 검토하고 있다. )

item.title: Defense Ministry: "No Discussion of USFK Reduction at All" … Following Trump's Remarks on Reducing US Forces in Germany (국방부 “주한미군 감축 논의 전혀 없다”…트럼프 주독미군 감축 발언 뒤)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense stated in relation to U.S. President Donald Trump's remarks about reviewing a reduction of U.S. troops stationed in Germany, "There is absolutely no discussion between South Korea and the United States regarding a reduction of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK)." (국방부는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 독일 주둔 미군 감축을 검토하고 있다고 언급한 것과 관련해 “한국과 미국 사이에 주한미군 감축에 대한 논의는 전혀 없다”고 밝혔다.)

At a regular briefing on the 30th, Defense Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said, "The primary mission of USFK is to maintain a robust combined defense posture alongside our military to deter and respond to North Korea's aggression and provocations." Spokesperson Jeong added, "Going forward, South Korea and the U.S. will continue to closely consult to ensure the stable stationing of USFK and strengthen the combined defense posture." (정빛나 국방부 대변인은 30일 정례브리핑에서 “주한미군의 주요 임무는 우리군과 함께 굳건한 연합방위태세를 갖춰 북한의 침략과 도발을 억제 및 대응하는 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 정 대변인은 “앞으로도 주한미군의 안정적 주둔과 연합방위태세 강화를 위해 한미간 긴밀히 협의해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

On the 29th (local time), President Trump stated via his social media platform Truth Social, "The United States is looking into the possibility of reducing troops stationed in Germany," adding, "A decision will be made soon." President Trump has consistently raised concerns about Europe's free-riding on security, and recently expressed dissatisfaction that Germany has not actively cooperated in the U.S.-Israel-Iran war. During his first term in 2020, President Trump also announced a plan to reduce about one-third of U.S. forces in Germany—approximately 11,900 troops—but the reduction was not implemented. (트럼프 대통령은 29일(현지시각) 소셜미디어 트루스소셜을 통해 “미국은 독일에 있는 병력의 감축 가능성을 살펴보고 있다”며 “조만간 결정이 내려질 것”이라고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 유럽의 안보 무임승차를 계속 문제 삼아왔고, 최근 독일이 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁에 적극 협조하지 않는다며 불만을 표시해왔다. 트럼프 대통령은 집권 1기인 2020년에도 주독미군 병력 중 3분의 1가량인 1만1900명을 감축하겠다고 발표했지만 실제로는 감축되지 않았다.)

If the background to the U.S. reduction of troops in Germany stems from dissatisfaction with Germany's security free-riding and lack of cooperation in the U.S.-Iran war, there are expectations that similar reasons could lead to a reduction of USFK. In April 2008, during the early days of the Lee Myung-bak administration, South Korea and the U.S. agreed at a summit to halt the reduction of USFK and maintain it at the current level of 28,500 troops. Since then, the official size of USFK has been 28,500. According to U.S. military data, the actual number of USFK personnel fluctuates between 23,000 and 26,000 each year. (미국이 주독미군 감축에 나선 배경이 독일의 안보 무임승차와 미국-이란전쟁에 대한 비협조에 대한 불만이라면 같은 이유로 주한미군을 감축할 가능성도 제기될 수 있다는 예상이 나온다. 이명박 정부 초기인 2008년 4월 한국과 미국이 정상회담에서 주한미군 감축을 중단하고 현 수순(2만8500명)으로 유지하기로 합의한 뒤 지금까지 주한미군 규모는 공식적으로 2만8500명이다. 미군 자료를 보면 실제 주한미군 병력은 해마다 2만3~6천명 수준을 오가고 있다.)

In a recent U.S. House of Representatives hearing, U.S. Forces Korea Commander Xavier Brunson stated, "The Korean Peninsula is a key strategic location for defending the U.S. homeland and advancing U.S. interests in the region," adding, "Our forces stationed in South Korea are undergoing modernization to respond to rapidly changing strategic challenges, which is why I focus on capabilities rather than troop numbers." (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 최근 미 하원 청문회에서 “한반도는 미국 본토를 방어하고 역내에서 미국의 이익을 증진하는 데 핵심적인 전략적 요충지”라며 “한국에 주둔한 우리 군은 급변하는 전략적 과제에 대응코자 현대화를 추진 중이며, 이는 제가 병력 숫자보다 역량에 초점을 맞추는 이유”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo's 'Hand Shake and Wipe' Controversy... Han Dong-hoon Says "Disrespects Citizens", People Power Party Calls It "Arrogance" (하정우 ‘ 악수 뒤 손 털기’ 논란…한동훈 “시민 무시”, 국힘 “오만”)
item.description:
Conservative factions, including the People Power Party, launched a unified offensive against the apparent gesture of Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI future strategies, who is virtually confirmed as the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election, after he was seen wiping his hands after a handshake. (국민의힘 등 보수 진영이 더불어민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 재보궐선거 후보로 사실상 확정된 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석의 악수 후 손을 터는 듯한 모습을 두고 일제히 총공세를 폈다.)

Han Dong-hoon, independent former leader of the People Power Party who declared his candidacy for Busan North Gap, wrote on Facebook on the 30th, "Is the Democratic Party thinking that ignoring the citizens of Buk-gu won't affect the overall trend?" He mentioned this after a current Democratic Party deputy spokesperson said on a broadcast that 'Ha Jung-woo's hand-wiping doesn't affect the big picture.' The previous day, after resigning from his senior role, the former senior secretary visited Gupo Market in Buk-gu for his first schedule in Busan. During this visit, footage captured him shaking hands with merchants and then rubbing his hands together or making a wiping motion. (부산 북갑 출마를 선언한 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표는 30일 페이스북에 “북구 시민들을 무시해도 대세에 지장 없다는 것이 민주당의 생각인가”라고 적었다. 그는 민주당 현직 부대변인이 방송에서 ‘하정우 손 털기는 대세에 지장 없다’고 했다면서 이렇게 밝혔다. 전날 하 전 수석은 수석직을 사퇴한 뒤 첫 부산 일정으로 북구 구포시장을 방문했다. 이 과정에서 상인들과 악수를 한 뒤 양손을 비비거나 손을 터는 듯한 모습이 현장 영상에 잡혔다.)

Park Min-sik, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs and a preliminary candidate for the People Power Party in North Gap, also commented, "That deeply rooted sense of elitism and arrogance, treating residents who have built up the area their whole lives as a 'different class' that can never mix with him, unconsciously burst out." (북갑 국민의힘 예비후보인 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관도 “평생 지역을 일궈온 주민들을 자신과는 결코 섞일 수 없는 ‘다른 부류’로 대하는 그 뿌리 깊은 선민의식과 오만함이 무의식중에 터져 나온 것”이라고 했다.)

The offensive continued in the People Power Party meeting hall. Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won stated at the Supreme Council meeting that day, "Yesterday, the former senior secretary shook hands with a few young merchants at the market and then suddenly wiped his hands as if they had gotten some filth on them," claiming, "The former senior secretary treats voters like bugs." Spokesperson Jo Yong-sool targeted him in a commentary, asking, "We can't help but ask if he wiped his hands like that even after shaking hands with powerful figures like President Lee Jae-myung and floor leader Jung Cheong-rae," adding, "Politics that mimic the aristocracy after rising in the world cannot win voters' choice." (국민의힘 회의장에서도 공세가 이어졌다. 김재원 최고위원은 이날 최고위원회의에서 “하 전 수석이 어제 시장의 젊은 상인 몇 분하고 악수하고는 갑자기 손에 무슨 오물이라도 묻은 듯이 손을 터는 장면이 있었다”며 “하 전 수석은 유권자를 벌레 취급하는 사람”이라고 주장했다. 조용술 대변인은 논평을 통해 “이재명 대통령과 정청래 대표 같은 권력자의 손을 잡은 뒤에도 그렇게 손을 닦았는지 묻지 않을 수 없다”며 “출세한 듯 귀족 흉내를 내는 정치로는 유권자의 선택을 받을 수 없다”고 겨냥했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop said on Channel A's YouTube, "Shaking hands with residents and then wiping his hands—it was so shocking. A horrifying scene," and struck directly, "President Lee sending out someone who lacks basic political etiquette is too arrogant." Pro-Han faction lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon asked, "Even if you had to pick, did you pick someone like this?" Former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk pointed out, "If he genuinely believes he's an elite who shouldn't shake hands with market merchants, someone exceptionally clean, then he'd better stay at the Blue House, discussing only grandiose and refined matters." (김재섭 의원은 채널에이(A) 유튜브에서 “주민과 악수하고 손을 털다니 너무 충격적이었다. 끔찍한 장면”이라며 “이 대통령이 정치에 대한 기본이 갖춰지지 않은 사람을 그냥 내려보낸 건 너무 오만해 보인다”고 직격했다. 친한(친한동훈)계 박정훈 의원은 “골라도 이런 사람을 골랐나”라고, 김종혁 전 최고위원은 “스스로를 시장 상인들과는 손잡으면 안 되는 엘리트고 특별히 깨끗한 존재라는 인식을 갖고 있다면 청와대에서 거창하고 고상한 논의만 하고 있는게 낫겠다”고 지적했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government Restores 'Unification Office' at Russian Embassy After One and a Half Years... Response to Tightening North Korea-Russia Ties (정부, 러 주재 ‘통일관’ 1년 반 만에 복원…북·러 밀착 대응)
item.description:
The position of the Unification and Security Attaché (Unification Attaché) at the South Korean Embassy in Russia will be restored after a one-and-a-half-year hiatus. This measure aims to monitor North Korea's activities and facilitate the restoration of inter-Korean relations, amid deepening ties between North Korea and Russia. (러시아 주재 한국대사관 통일안보관(통일관) 자리가 1년 반 만에 복원된다. 북한과 러시아 간 밀착이 심화되는 가운데 북한 동향을 파악하고, 남북 관계 복원을 위한 조처다.)

On the 30th, the Ministry of Unification announced the commencement of the recruitment process for the Unification Attaché (at the director level) at the South Korean Embassy in Russia. Applications will be accepted from the 4th to the 11th of next month, followed by document screening and interviews, with the final successful candidate expected to be announced around July. The new Unification Attaché is scheduled to take office in August, with a term of three years. The position of Unification Attaché at the South Korean Embassy in Russia was first created in 2012 during the Lee Myung-bak administration as part of unification diplomacy. However, it was abolished in February last year under the efficiency policy established in 2022 during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, and this move fills the vacancy after about 14 months. Typically, the Unification Attaché assigned to embassies is a government official from the Ministry of Unification. <<> Under the Lee Jae-myung administration, there have been persistent calls for the restoration of the Unification Attaché post in Russia. Given that the closeness between North Korea and Russia has solidified since the Ukraine war, while South Korea-Russia relations remain strained, the rationale is to focus attention on Russia and broaden the scope of unification diplomatic activities. North Korea and Russia have recently been discussing the signing of a five-year mid-to-long-term military cooperation plan, among other measures, signaling a trend of strengthening military cooperation. <<> Unification Attachés stationed abroad are responsible for monitoring trends related to inter-Korean relations and the host country's North Korea policy, supporting unification-related activities, and securing support for the South Korean government's North Korea policy. Currently, Unification Attachés are dispatched to overseas missions in four countries: the United States, China, Japan, and Germany. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (30일 통일부는 주러시아 한국대사관 통일관(과장급) 공모 절차를 시작한다고 밝혔다. 다음 달 4~11일 원서를 접수한 뒤 서류심사와 면접을 거쳐 7월께 최종 합격자를 발표할 계획이다. 신임 통일관은 8월 부임 예정이며, 임기는 3년이다. 주러시아대사관 통일관 보직은 이명박 정부 시절인 2012년 통일외교 차원에서 신설됐다. 그러나 윤석열 정부 시절인 2022년 세운 인력 효율화 방침에 따라 지난해 2월 폐지됐고, 이번에 14개월여 만에 공석을 메꾸게 된 것이다. 통상 대사관에 파견되는 통일관은 통일부 소속 공무원들이 맡았다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry Investigation Bureau Launches Probe into Allegations of Insurrection Support and Political Orientation Collection by Counterintelligence Command (국방부조사본부, 내란 옹호·정치 성향 수집 의혹 방첩사 수사 착수)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 30th that it has launched an investigation into allegations that the Defense Counterintelligence Command (DCIC) internally justified an illegal martial law declaration and collected soldiers' political leanings. (국방부가 국군방첩사령부(방첩사) 내부에서 불법 비상계엄을 옹호하고 군인들 정치 성향을 수집한다는 의혹과 관련해 수사에 착수했다고 30일 밝혔다.)

Spokesperson Jeong Bit-na stated during a regular briefing that day, "Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-back ordered the Defense Ministry Investigation Bureau on the 28th to transparently and objectively verify the facts. Following the minister's directive, the Investigation Bureau has now commenced its investigation." Spokesperson Jeong added, "If the Investigation Bureau's probe confirms any deviant behavior that still fails to break free from old malpractices, strict action will be taken." (정빛나 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 28일 국방부조사본부에 투명하고 객관적으로 사실관계를 확인하라고 지시했고, 조사본부는 장관 지시에 따라 현재 수사에 착수한 상태”라고 밝혔다. 정 대변인은 “조사본부 수사를 통해 여전히 악습에서 벗어나지 못한 일탈행위가 확인될 시에는 엄중히 조치할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Earlier, JTBC reported, citing insider testimonies from within the DCIC, that some members of the command were justifying the insurrection, claiming "the martial law was legitimate and intended to protect the free Republic of Korea," or mocking specific unit members by comparing them to supporters of President Lee Jae-myung. The DCIC has denied all related reports. (앞서 제이티비시(JTBC)는 방첩사 내부자 증언을 인용해, 일부 방첩사 구성원들이 ‘계엄은 정당하며 자유 한국을 수호하기 위한 것’이라며 내란을 옹호하거나 특정 부대원을 이재명 대통령 지지자에 빗대 조롱했다고 보도했다. 방첩사는 관련 보도들을 모두 부인하고 있다.)

President Lee Jae-myung, referring to the report during a Cabinet meeting on the 28th, said, "It was reported that a certain unit within the military investigated whether personnel had voted for me or not, even after my inauguration." In response, Minister Ahn stated during the same Cabinet meeting, "I have checked from multiple angles and requested an investigation by the Investigation Bureau, but we were able to confirm that the report contained inaccuracies." President Lee then instructed, "Please report the findings later." (이재명 대통령은 지난 28일 국무회의에서 해당 보도를 거론하면서 “국군 내 모 부대에서 ‘너 이재명 찍었냐, 안 찍었냐’ 이걸 제가 취임한 이후에도 조사했다고 보도했다”고 말했다. 당시 국무회의 석상에서 안 장관은 “제가 다각도로 확인하고 조사본부로 하여금 조사를 의뢰하고 왔지만 사실과 다른 점을 확인할 수 있었다”라고 말했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “나중에 결과 보고를 해달라”라고 지시했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense is pursuing a plan to disband the DCIC, which played a leading role in the December 3 insurrection by attempting to arrest key political figures and seize control of the National Election Commission, and to establish a new "National Defense Counterintelligence Headquarters," a "National Defense Information Security Policy Office," and a "National Defense Security Support Group" to distribute its main functions. (국방부는 주요 정치인 체포와 중앙선거관리위원회 장악에 나서는 등 12·3 내란에 앞장선 방첩사를 해체하고 ‘국방방첩본부’와 ‘국방부 정보보안정책관’, ‘국방보안지원단’을 신설해 주요 기능을 분산하는 방안을 추진 중이다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Says “Severe Punishment Deserved” for 50-Year-Old Who Defamed Sewol Ferry and Itaewon Victims (이 대통령, 세월호·이태원 피해자 비방 50대 구속에 “엄벌 마땅”)
item.description:
On the 30th, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the arrest of a man in his 50s who repeatedly mocked victims of the Sewol Ferry and Itaewon disasters: “Inhuman fake news and insulting comments deserve severe punishment.” (이재명 대통령이 30일 세월호·이태원 참사 피해자를 반복적으로 조롱한 50대 남성이 구속된 사건에 대해 “인면수심의 가짜뉴스, 모욕적 댓글은 엄벌해 마땅하다”고 말했다.)

The president shared a related article on X (formerly Twitter) and said, “Going forward, the police dedicated team will sternly respond to fake news or secondary harm comments.” (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X)에 관련의 기사를 공유하며 “향후에도 가짜뉴스나 2차 가해 댓글 등에는 경찰 전담팀이 엄정하게 대응할 것”이라고 말했다.)

The National Police Agency’s National Investigation Headquarters announced on the same day that it had arrested Mr. A, a man in his 50s suspected of repeatedly posting over 70 items of false claims related to the disasters and defamatory posts about the victims’ families. The Secondary Harm Crime Investigation Division, which investigated this case, was established after President Lee ordered the police in July of last year to “create a dedicated team to investigate secondary harm crimes, such as malicious comments targeting the families of social disaster victims.” (경찰청 국가수사본부는 이날 참사 관련 허위 주장과 유가족 비방글 70여건을 반복적으로 올린 혐의를 받는 50대 남성 ㄱ씨를 구속했다고 밝혔다. 이 사건을 수사한 2차가해범죄수사과는 이 대통령이 지난해 7월 경찰에 “사회적 참사 유가족 등을 대상으로 한 악성 댓글 등 2차 가해 범죄를 수사할 전담팀을 만들라”고 지시하며 출범했다.)

Reporter Goh Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Chung Jin-suk, 'Chief of Staff to the Insurrection President', Rumored to Run... Kim Jae-won: "We Need His Insight" (‘내란 대통령의 비서실장’ 정진석 출마설…김재원 “그분 식견 필요”)
item.description:
Amid speculation that former lawmaker Chung Jin-suk, who served as Chief of Staff to former President Yoon Suk Yeol during the December 3 martial law declaration, might run as the People Power Party candidate in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, People Power Party Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won expressed a positive stance, stating, "The political insight he possesses is still needed by our party." (12·3 비상계엄 당시 윤석열 전 대통령 비서실장이던 정진석 전 의원이 충남 공주·부여·청양에 국민의힘 소속으로 출마할 가능성이 제기되는 가운데, 김재원 국민의힘 최고위원은 “그분이 가진 정치적인 식견이 우리당에 지금도 필요하다”며 긍정적 입장을 밝혔다.)

Supreme Council member Kim made these remarks on the 30th during an appearance on YTN Radio's 'Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang'. When asked by the host about the possibility of former Chief of Staff Chung receiving the party nomination, Kim said, "If a candidate can lead us to victory, we should field that person." He added, "There are many candidates our party is putting forward for this by-election, but the only district where we created the vacancy for this by-election is Dalseong-gun in Daegu. So, winning even a single seat would be a victory." <<> In response to a question about whether the 'insurrection narrative' would hurt his electoral appeal, Kim replied, "Former Chief of Staff Chung is someone who has been judicially shown to have absolutely no connection to the declaration of martial law, even though it has been labeled 'insurrection'." When the host argued that as chief of staff at the time of the martial law declaration, he bears overall responsibility, Kim asserted, "If he bore such responsibility, he would have been implicated in all the special counsel investigations into the insurrection or the numerous judicial entanglements this administration has spawned, but instead, it has become clear that he was not involved." <<> Supreme Council member Kim further stated, "Currently, we are in a position where we are desperate for even a single seat, so we should approach this with the mindset of fielding anyone who can increase our number of seats—even you, Director Jang (the host), although there might be some opposition within the party." <<> However, the rumors of former Chief of Staff Chung's candidacy have faced backlash. Gongju-based civic group 'Gongju, Buyeo, Cheongyang Future Politics Reform Citizen Alliance' held a press conference in front of Gongsanseong Fortress in Gongju on the 29th, stating they "strongly oppose" the move. They argued, "Former Chief of Staff Chung is a key figure of the Yoon Suk Yeol administration entangled in serious judicial risks linked to the insurrection conspiracy, such as the 'martial law crisis,'" and asked, "Is he trying to evade the blade of investigative authorities by using a lawmaker's immunity from arrest as a shield?" <<> The Gongju Participatory Self-Governing Citizen Alliance also issued a statement on the 28th, asserting, "(Former Chief of Staff Chung) is the last chief of staff of the Yoon Suk Yeol regime and bears heavy responsibility for the insurrection crisis and the resulting national chaos," and declared, "Any attempt to run for office is absolutely unacceptable." <<> Meanwhile, the National Police Agency's Special Investigation Headquarters for the 3rd Special Counsel sent former Chief of Staff Chung's case to the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office on February 24 without detention, on charges including damaging public electronic records, abuse of authority obstructing the exercise of rights, and violating the Presidential Records Management Act. Chung is suspected of ordering the reset of all computers in the presidential office immediately after former President Yoon's impeachment, in an attempt to destroy evidence related to the December 3 insurrection crisis. <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (김 최고위원은 30일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 이같이 말했다. 김 최고위원은 ‘정 전 실장 공천 가능성에 대해 어떻게 생각하냐’는 진행자의 질문에 “우리가 승리할 수 있는 후보라면 누구든지 내보내는 것이 맞다”고 말했다. 김 최고위원은 “이번 보궐선거에 우리 당이 내세우는 후보들은 많지만, 우리 당에서 그 보궐선거를 만든 지역은 대구 달성군밖에 없다”며 “그러니까 한 석이라도 가져오면 승리다”라고 했다.)

item.title: Army Chief: "After 2030, All Soldiers Will Have Drone Operation Capabilities" (육군총장 “2030년 이후엔 전 장병이 드론 운용 능력 갖출 것”)
item.description:
Army Chief of Staff General Kim Gyu-ha stated, "I think of drones as personal weapons for the future," expressing his intention to intensively develop drone forces, often called the 'game changer' of modern warfare. (김규하 육군참모총장이 “드론(무인기)은 앞으로 개인화기로 생각한다”며 현대전의 ‘게임 체인저’로 불리는 드론 전력을 집중 육성할 뜻을 밝혔다.)

General Kim made these remarks at a policy briefing for the defense correspondent corps held at the Army headquarters in Gyeryongdae, South Chungcheong Province, on the 29th, adding, "We will ensure that all combatants can operate drones freely." This is part of the Ministry of National Defense's policy to foster '500,000 drone warriors.' (김 총장은 지난 29일 충남 계룡대 육군본부에서 열린 국방부 출입기자단 정책설명회에서 이렇게 말하며 “(드론을) 전투원이 모두 자유자재로 운용할 수 있도록 할 것”이라고 했다. 국방부가 밝힌 ‘50만 드론전사’ 육성 방침의 일환이다.)

The Army plans to first organize drone units in all echelons and field self-destruct and reconnaissance drones at the battalion level. Currently, drone systems are mainly deployed along the front lines and at key facilities, but the goal is to expand them to small units, including individuals and vehicles, by 2027, and to ensure all soldiers have drone operation capabilities after 2030. General Kim said, "Drones will evolve not only for surveillance and reconnaissance but also for strike and sustained support missions." (육군은 우선, 모든 제대에 드론 부대를 편성하고 대대급 단위에서 자폭·정찰드론을 전력화할 계획이다. 현재는 전방과 중요시설 위주로 드론 체계가 구축됐지만, 2027년까지 개인과 단차를 포함한 소부대로 확장하고, 2030년 이후엔 전 장병이 드론 운용 능력을 구비할 수 있도록 하겠다는 목표다. 김 총장은 “드론은 감시·정찰뿐 아니라 타격, 지속지원 작전을 위한 용도로도 발전될 것”이라고 말했다.)

General Kim also said, "It is true that since 2018, we set policies for the drone-bot (a compound of drone and robot) combat system, but technological progress lagged behind, causing stagnation. However, we are close to realizing our 2028-2030 goals. We must advance Korea's drone operational power system and doctrine." (김 총장은 또 “2018년부터 드론봇(드론과 로봇의 합성어) 전투체계 정책을 설정했지만, 기술적 진보가 못 따라가 정체됐던 건 사실”이라며 “(그러나) 2028∼2030년 (목표) 실현에 성큼 와 있다. 한국의 드론 운영 전력체계와 교리를 발전시켜야 한다”고 말했다.)

The Army also plans to introduce over 50,000 educational drones by 2029. To establish strategies, education, and doctrines for the '500,000 drone warriors,' they are preparing along five axes, including improvement, structure, and maintenance support. This year, about 10,000 commercial educational drones will be introduced, with a total of 50,000 coming into the Ministry of National Defense by 2029. Army Policy Director Lee Kyung-jin said, "This means one drone per squad." (육군은 2029년까지 교육용 드론 5만여대도 도입할 계획이다. ‘50만 드론전사’에 대한 전략과 교육, 교리를 갖추기 위해 개선, 구조, 정비 지원 등 5개 축으로 준비하고 있고, 올해 교육용 상용드론 1만여대, 2029년까지 5만여대가 국방부로 들어온다고 한다. 이경진 육군 정책실장은 “분대별로 1대씩 들어가는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the reduction of guard troops at the front-line guard posts (GOPs), General Kim stated, "It is not about an immediate reduction," adding, "I believe it will be possible by 2040." Earlier, Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek announced in April a plan to reduce guard post troops from the current 22,000 level to 6,000. General Kim said, "We are piloting an AI-based scientific surveillance system in two divisions, and it is effective. We are reducing vulnerabilities." (한편, 김 총장은 최전방 경계초소(GOP) 경계병 감축과 관련해 “당장 줄이는 개념은 아니”라며 “2040년이면 가능할 것으로 본다”고 말했다. 앞서, 안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 4월 경계초소 병력을 현 2만2000명 수준에서 6000명까지 감축하겠다는 계획을 밝힌 바 있다. 김 총장은 “현재 2개 사단에 인공지능(AI) 기반 과학화 경계시스템을 시범 운영 중인데, 효과가 있다. 허점을 줄여 나가고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee takes aim at Samsung Electronics union? “Demands made only for one’s own survival harm other workers” (이 대통령, 삼전 노조 저격? “자기만 살겠다는 요구, 다른 노동자에 피해”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 30th, “When some organized workers make unfair or excessive demands just to survive on their own, and face criticism from the public, it inflicts significant harm not only on that union but also on other workers.” (이재명 대통령이 30일 “일부 조직노동자가 자기만 살겠다고 부당한 요구, 과도한 요구를 해서 우리 국민들에게 지탄받게 되면 해당 노조뿐 아니라 다른 노동자에게도 큰 피해를 입히게 된다”고 말했다.)

During a meeting of senior secretaries held at the presidential office, President Lee stated, “The power of workers, who are inevitably the weaker party in employment, comes from solidarity with fellow workers in the same position. That is the reason for guaranteeing the three fundamental labor rights.” He added, “We need a sense of solidarity that goes beyond just one’s own survival, aiming for all workers and all citizens to thrive together.” President Lee continued, “In our national family, some are workers and some will be employers. I hope we can think of everyone as equal members of South Korea and practice empathy to create a world where we all live together.” (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “고용에 있어서 약자일 수밖에 없는 노동자의 힘은 같은 입장을 가진 노동자들과 연대에서 나온다. 노동3권 보장도 그런 이유”라며 “나만 살자는 게 아니라 노동자 모두가, 국민 모두가 함께 살 수 있는 연대 의식이 필요하다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “우리 국민 가족 중 누군가는 노동자고, 누군가는 사용자가 될 것이다. 모두가 똑같은 대한민국 구성원이라고 생각하고 역지사지하면서 함께 사는 세상을 만들면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee’s remarks on this day appear to be an indirect reference to the Samsung Electronics union, which has announced a general strike. The union demands a 15% performance bonus based on operating profit and has stated that if management does not accept, they will hold a general strike for 18 days starting May 21. (이 대통령의 이날 발언은 총파업을 예고한 삼성전자 노조를 에둘러 거론한 것으로 보인다. 삼성전자 노조는 영업이익의 15% 성과급을 요구하며 사쪽이 받아들이지 않은 경우 5월21일부터 18일간 총파업을 하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Additionally, ahead of the first Labor Day designated as a statutory public holiday in 63 years, President Lee said, “This year, Labor Day has not only regained its rightful name but has also been designated as a statutory public holiday, making its meaning particularly special.” The ‘Workers’ Day,’ which began with the enactment of a law in 1963, saw its name changed to ‘Labor Day’ when the ‘Labor Day Establishment Act’ was passed at a plenary session of the National Assembly in October last year, and it was designated as the first statutory public holiday. (아울러 이 대통령은 63년 만에 법정공휴일로 지정된 첫 노동절을 앞두고 “올해부터 노동절이 노동이라는 정당한 이름을 되찾았을 뿐 아니라 법정공휴일로 지정돼 그 의미가 각별하다”고 말했다. 1963년 법 제정으로 시작된 ‘근로자의 날’은 지난해 10월 국회 본회의에서 ‘노동절 제정에 관한 법률’이 통과되며 명칭이 ‘노동절’로 바뀌었고, 첫 법정공휴일로 지정됐다.)

President Lee emphasized, “To build a country where labor is respected and well-treated, it is crucial to reduce disparities in the labor market. We must also accelerate efforts to ensure safety in the work environment.” He added, “While policy effects are becoming visible recently, such as a decline in occupational fatalities, we need to speed up improvements in related systems, including strengthening on-site supervision. The working conditions of non-regular workers must also be improved in a fair and rational direction. Since the government is the largest employer in South Korea, it should first set an example as an exemplary employer.” (이 대통령은 “노동이 존중받고 대접받는 나라를 만들려면 노동시장 격차완화가 중요하다”며 “작업환경의 안전에도 박차를 가해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “최근 산재 사망자가 감소하는 등 정책효과가 가시화되고 있지만, 현장감독 강화 등 관련 제도 개선에도 속도를 내야 한다”며 “비정규직 노동조건 역시 공정하고 합리적인 방향으로 개선해야 한다. 대한민국에서는 정부가 가장 큰 사용자인 만큼 정부부터 모범적인 사용자 모습을 보여줘야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee further stated, “The great transformation driven by artificial intelligence is exposing labor and industrial sites to fundamental changes. To overcome these significant challenges, a spirit of coexistence and cooperation is necessary. Employers should treat workers as valuable partners in business operations, and workers should also share a sense of responsibility. I hope that workers will demonstrate mutual solidarity.” (이 대통령은 또 “인공지능 대전환으로 노동과 산업현장이 근본적인 변화에 노출된다”며 “중대한 도전을 이겨내려면 상생과 협력 정신이 필요하다. 사측은 노동자를 기업운영의 소중한 동반자로 대우해야 하고, 노동자도 책임의식을 함께 가져야 한다. 노동자 상호간 연대 의식을 발휘해주면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] People Power Party's Seoul Candidate Convention: 'Separate Rice and Soup' Despite Election Looming ([포토] 선거가 코앞인데 ‘따로국밥’인 국민의힘 서울시 공천자대회)
item.description:
The 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections People Power Party Seoul Metropolitan Party Victory Pledge and Candidate Convention was held on the morning of the 30th at the Grand Conference Room of the National Assembly Members' Office Building in Yeouido, Seoul. The event was a success, drawing candidates running in the June 3 local elections, including Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, and Bae Hyun-jin, the Seoul Metropolitan Party chairwoman, as well as candidates for heads of basic local governments, the Seoul Metropolitan Council, and basic councils. For the People Power Party, which has recently been struggling in various opinion polls, this was an important occasion to regroup their scattered ranks and pledge victory in the local elections. (제9회 전국동시지방선거 국민의힘 서울시당 필승결의 및 공천자대회가 30일 오전 서울 여의도 국회 의원회관 대회의실에서 열렸다. 이 자리에는 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보와 배현진 서울시당 위원장을 비롯한 기초단체장 후보들과 서울시의회 후보, 기초의회 후보 등 이번 6·3 지방선거에 출마하는 후보들이 참석해 성황을 이루었다. 최근 각종 여론조사에서 고전을 면치 못하는 국민의힘으로선 흐트러진 전열을 가다듬고 지방선거 필승을 다짐하는 중요한 자리였다.)

However, before the event began, the name tags attached to the seats of key attendees did not include the name of Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk, the party leader representing the People Power Party. While there were seats for former floor leader Kim Seong-tae and former emergency committee chairperson Kwon Young-se, no seat was even prepared for Rep. Jang, who naturally bears the immense responsibility of leading this election from the party's front lines. This was in stark contrast to the movements of Rep. Na Kyung-won and former emergency committee chairperson Kwon Young-se, who attended only the early part of the event starting at 10 AM due to personal schedules, and Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk, whose attendance on that day made it hard to tell whether he chose not to attend or was unable to do so. (그러나 행사 시작 전 주요 참석자들의 의자에 붙어있는 이름표에는 정작 국민의힘을 대표하는 장동혁 당대표의 이름은 보이지 않았다. 김성태 전 원내대표의 자리도 있었고 권영세 전 비상대책위원장의 자리도 있었지만 당연히 당의 최전선에서 이번 선거를 진두지휘해야 할 막중한 책임이 있는 장 대표의 자리는 아예 마련조차 안 됐다. 오전 10시부터 시작한 행사에 개인 일정을 이유로 초반에만 참석한 나경원 의원 및 권영세 전 비상대책위원장과 아예 참석 자체를 안 한 건지 못한 건지 구분하기 힘든 장동혁 대표의 이날 행보는 대조적이었다.)

Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk, who did not attend the Seoul Metropolitan Party Victory Pledge Convention held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building that day, instead participated in a small business owners' association policy proposal event held from 10:30 AM on the second floor of the main National Assembly building, a five-minute walk from the Members' Office Building. Floor leader Song Eon-seok visited the Noryangjin Fisheries Wholesale Market at 11 AM for a public welfare field trip. (이날 국회 의원회관에서 열린 서울시당 필승결의대회에 참석하지 않은 장동혁 대표는 오전 10시30분부터 의원회관과 걸어서 5분여 떨어진 국회 본관 2층에서 열린 소상공인연합회 정책 과제 전달식에 참석했고, 송언석 원내대표는 오전 11시로 예정된 노량진 수산시장을 찾아 민생 현장 행보에 나섰다.)

The movements of the party leader and the party's Seoul mayoral candidate were also at odds the previous day. The day before, on the 29th, Candidate Oh Se-hoon did not attend an event organized by Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk, who had announced youth pledges at a café near the Hongjecheon artificial waterfall in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, to support him as the party's Seoul mayoral candidate. Meanwhile, Bae Hyun-jin, the chairman of the Seoul Metropolitan Party and a close associate of Han Dong-hoon, has been criticizing Rep. Jang, saying, "The worst act of delinquency is all of Chairman Jang's choices that trip up candidates and crash the party's competitiveness." ( 대표와 당 서울시장 후보의 행보는 전날에도 엇갈렸다. 오세훈 후보는 하루 전인 29일, 당의 서울시장 후보인 자신을 지원하기 위해 서울 서대문구 홍제천 인공폭포 인근 카페에서 청년 공약을 발표한 장동혁 대표의 행사에 참석하지 않았다. 한편 친한동훈계인 배현진 서울시당 위원장은 “최악의 해당 행위는 후보들 발목잡고 당의 경쟁률을 곤두박질치게 하는 장 대표의 모든 선택”이라고 하는 등 장 대표를 비판해왔다. )

()

()

Yoon Woon-sik, Senior Correspondent yws@hani.co.kr (윤운식 선임기자 yws@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Review whether teachers face unreasonable burdens regarding field trips" (이 대통령 “체험학습 관련, 교사 불합리한 부담 없는지 검토하라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung ordered on the 30th, "The Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Education should review whether there are any unreasonable burdens on teachers regarding legal liability and immunity in relation to school field trips." (이재명 대통령이 30일 “학교의 현장 체험학습과 관련해 교사의 법률 책임 및 면책 영역에 있어 불합리한 부담이 없는지 법무부와 교육부가 검토하라”고 지시했다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung said in a briefing after a meeting of senior presidential secretaries chaired by the president at the Blue House, "President Lee instructed to gather opinions from various sectors including teachers, parents, and experts through a public debate process regarding school field trips." This measure comes amid growing controversy over excessive liability being placed on individual teachers for safety accidents during field trips. (강유정 수석대변인은 이날 청와대에서 열린 대통령 주재 수석보좌관회의 뒤 브리핑에서 “이 대통령이 학교 현장 체험학습 관련해 교사, 부모, 전문가 등 각계각층의 의견을 공개적 토론 과정을 통해 수렴하라고 지시했다”고 말했다. 최근 현장 체험학습 중 안전사고와 관련해 교사 개인에게 책임이 과도하게 전가된다는 논란이 커진 데 따른 조처다.)

President Lee said at a cabinet meeting on the 28th, "If you're worried about maggots appearing, you shouldn't remove the soy sauce jar," adding, "Field trips are also important educational activities. If there are problems, they should be corrected, and students should be able to participate through cost support, additional safety personnel, or hiring more staff." In response, the Korean Federation of Teachers' Associations stated in a commentary, "If the structure where individual teachers bear all legal responsibility in case of accidents does not change, normalizing field trips will remain distant." (이 대통령은 지난 28일 국무회의에서 “구더기 생기지 않을까 싶어 장독을 없애면 안 된다”며 “현장 체험학습도 중요한 교육활동인데 문제가 있으면 교정하고 비용 지원이나 안전요원 보강, 인력 추가 채용을 통해 학생들이 실시할 수 있도록 해야 한다”고 말했다. 그러자 한국교원단체총연합회는 논평을 통해 “사고 발생 시 모든 법적 책임을 교사 개인이 짊어져야 하는 구조가 바뀌지 않는다면 체험학습 정상화는 요원할 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.)

item.title: 'Amid 'Hand Shake Shake' Controversy, Ha Jung-woo Says, 'This Is the Reality of Political Negativity' (‘손털기’ 논란에 하정우 “이런 게 현실 정치의 네거티브 실감”)
item.description:
The conservative camp launched a fierce attack on May 30 over Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the June 3 by-election in Busan's Buk-gu District, after he appeared to shake off his hand after a handshake. Candidate Ha countered, calling it "negativity." (6·3 국회의원 보궐선거 부산 북갑 하정우 더불어민주당 후보의 ‘악수 뒤 손 털기’를 두고 보수 진영이 30일 맹공을 퍼부었다. 하 후보는 “네거티브”라고 반박했다.)

Park Min-sik, the People Power Party's preliminary candidate for Buk-gu in Busan, criticized, "That deep-rooted elitism and arrogance toward residents who have cultivated the region for a lifetime, treating them as a 'different class' that can never mix with him, has unconsciously burst out." The controversy erupted after footage spread online of Ha shaking hands with merchants at Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, the previous day, followed by him rubbing his hands together or appearing to shake them off. (박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 예비후보는 이날 “평생 지역을 일궈온 주민들을 자신과는 결코 섞일 수 없는 ‘다른 부류’로 대하는 그 뿌리 깊은 선민의식과 오만함이 무의식중에 터져 나온 것”이라고 비판했다. 하 후보는 전날 부산 북구 구포시장 상인들과 악수를 한 뒤 양손을 비비거나 손을 터는 듯한 모습이 온라인상에 퍼져나가면서 입길에 올랐다.)

Kim Jae-won, a supreme council member of the same party, also fiercely condemned the act during a party supreme council meeting, saying, "It's a scene of shaking off his hand as if it had been dirtied by some filth" and "Former Senior Secretary Ha treats voters like insects." (같은 당 김재원 최고위원도 국회 최고위원회의에서 “무슨 오물이라도 묻은 듯이 손을 터는 장면”이라며 “하 전 수석은 유권자를 벌레 취급하는 사람”이라고 맹비난했다.)

Han Dong-hoon, the former People Power Party leader running as an independent in Busan's Buk-gu District, also shared a video on Facebook showing a Democratic Party deputy spokesperson saying, "Ha Jung-woo's hand-shaking incident doesn't affect the overall trend," adding, "Is the Democratic Party thinking that disregarding Buk-gu citizens won't matter in the big picture?" People Power Party lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon, from the pro-Han faction, also wrote on Facebook, "Shaking hands with voters and then shaking off his hand seems to be a habit. Did the Democratic Party pick someone like this on purpose?" (부산 북갑 출마를 선언한 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 역시 페이스북에 “북구 시민들을 무시해도 대세에 지장 없다는 것이 민주당의 생각인가”라며 한 민주당 부대변인이 ‘하정우 손 털기는 대세에 지장 없다’고 말하는 영상을 공유했다. 친한(친한동훈)계인 박정훈 국민의힘 의원도 “유권자와 악수하고 손 터는 게 습관인가 보다. (민주당이) 골라도 이런 사람을 골랐나”라고 페이스북에 썼다.)

As the controversy spread, Candidate Ha held a press briefing at the Busan City Council, stating, "This was my first time shaking hands with hundreds to nearly a thousand people in a day," and added, "By the end, my hand was numb, so I think I made an unconscious hand gesture." He continued, "I regret that misunderstandings can happen, but seeing them attack me as if I had some intention makes me realize this is the negativity of real politics." (논란이 확산하자 하 후보는 부산시의회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “하루에 수백∼1천명 가까이 되는 분들과 악수를 처음 해봤다”며 “마지막이 되니 손이 저려서 무의식적으로 손동작을 한 것 같다”고 말했다. 이어 “오해는 하실 수 있다는 점에서 유감스럽게 생각하지만, (제가) 어떤 의도를 가졌다고 공격하는 걸 보니 이런 게 현실 정치의 네거티브라는 생각이 든다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Candidate Ha paid respects at the Chungnyeol Tower in Busan's Central Park that morning alongside Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party candidate for Busan mayor. This appears to be a move to serve as Jeon's running mate, boosting his own local recognition and aiming to attract votes for both candidates. The Democratic Party officially announced that afternoon that it would strategically nominate Ha for the Buk-gu by-election. (한편, 하 후보는 이날 오전 같은 당 전재수 부산시장 후보와 함께 부산 중앙공원 충혼탑에 참배했다. 전 후보의 러닝메이트 구실을 하며 지역에서 인지도를 끌어올리고, 표심 쌍끌이를 하려는 행보로 보인다. 민주당은 이날 오후 하 전 수석을 북갑 보궐선거에 전략공천한다고 공식 발표했다.)

item.title: Former Chief of Staff Jeong Jin-seok Announces Candidacy for By-Election... Lee Jin-sook Applies for Nomination in Daegu Dalseong (정진석 전 비서실장, 재보선 출마선언…이진숙은 대구 달성 공천신청)
item.description:
Jeong Jin-seok, a former lawmaker of the People Power Party who served as Chief of Staff to former President Yoon Suk Yeol during the December 3 emergency martial law declaration, announced his candidacy on the 30th for the June 3 by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong Province. In Daegu Dalseong, where a by-election is being held due to the resignation of Daegu Mayor candidate Choo Kyung-ho from his parliamentary seat, former Korea Communications Commission Chairperson Lee Jin-sook applied for nomination. Amid the People Power Party's candidate shortage, aides of former President Yoon are stepping to the forefront of the election. (12·3 비상계엄 선포 당시 윤석열 전 대통령의 비서실장이던 정진석 전 국민의힘 의원이 30일 6·3 충남 공주·부여·청양 보궐선거 출마를 선언했다. 추경호 대구시장 후보의 의원직 사퇴로 보궐선거가 열리는 대구 달성에는 이진숙 전 방송통신위원장이 공천을 신청했다. 후보 기근을 겪는 국민의힘에서 윤 전 대통령의 측근들이 선거 전면에 등장하는 모양새다.)

Former Chief of Staff Jeong stated on Facebook that day: "In the current state of emergency, I could not turn away from my final duty to rebuild the party and conservatism. I will restore parliamentarism in the National Assembly and straighten out our camp." Regarding former President Yoon's declaration of martial law, he said, "It was a bolt from the blue," but added, "I have not the slightest intention of severing my personal ties (with former President Yoon). I believe no one should force anyone to personally cut ties with former President Yoon. That would be too harsh." ( 정 전 비서실장은 이날 페이스북에 “지금의 비상 상황에서 당과 보수의 재건을 위한 제 마지막 책무를 외면할 수 없었다. 국회에서 의회주의를, 우리 진영을 바로 세우겠다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. 윤 전 대통령의 계엄 선포와 관련해서는 “마른하늘의 날벼락이었다”면서도 “(윤 전 대통령과) 인간적 관계를 끊을 생각은 추호도 없다. 그 누구도 인간적인 절윤(윤 전 대통령과의 절연)까지 강요해서는 안 된다고 생각한다. 그건 너무 가혹한 일”이라고 했다.)

Former Chairperson Lee Jin-sook also applied for nomination in the Daegu Dalseong by-election that day. She has consistently argued for the "principle of presumption of innocence" regarding former President Yoon's insurrection charges, and in an interview with The Hankyoreh on the 22nd, she pushed back by asking, "Are the 'Yoon Again' people criminals?" ( 이진숙 전 위원장도 이날 대구 달성 보궐선거 공천을 신청했다. 윤 전 대통령 내란 혐의에 대해 ‘무죄 추정의 원칙’을 주장해온 그는 지난 22일 한겨레와 한 인터뷰에서 “윤 어게인이 범죄자들이냐”고 반발한 바 있다.)

Additionally, former lawmaker Lee Yong, who served as the head of former President Yoon's executive office during the presidential election process and was called "Yoon Suk Yeol's bodyguard," applied for nomination in the by-election for the Hanam-gap National Assembly seat. He is a figure who has publicly declared his opposition to the impeachment of former President Yoon. In Ulsan Nam-gap, pro-Yoon (pro-Yoon Suk Yeol) figure Kim Tae-gyu, who served as Vice Chairperson of the Korea Communications Commission and now serves as the Ulsan Nam-gap district party committee chairperson, has also completed his nomination application. ( 이 밖에도 대선 과정에서 윤 전 대통령의 수행실장을 맡아 ‘윤석열 호위무사’로 불린 이용 전 의원은 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 공천 신청을 했다. 그는 윤 전 대통령 ‘탄핵 반대’를 공개적으로 밝힌 인물이다. 울산 남갑에는 방송통신위원회 부위원장을 지낸 친윤(친윤석열)계 김태규 울산 남갑 당협위원장이 공천 신청을 마쳤다.)

The party appears to be feeling burdened by this. A lawmaker from the Yeongnam region commented, "This inevitably ties in with local elections, but if the 'Yoon Again' label gets attached in an already unfavorable situation, how are we supposed to run the election?" A party leadership official remarked, "Anyone has the right to run for office, and we can't exactly stop them." ( 당은 부담스러워하는 분위기다. 영남권의 한 의원은 “지방선거랑 연계될 수밖에 없는데 가뜩이나 안 좋은 상황에 ‘윤 어게인’ 딱지까지 붙으면 선거를 어떻게 치르겠단 거냐”고 했다. 당 지도부 관계자는 “누구나 선거에 출마할 권리가 있는데 막을 수도 없지 않으냐”고 했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ( 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)
